newsitem.title: USA: United Industrial subsidiary shares contract.
newsitem.headline: United Industrial subsidiary shares contract.

text.p: United Industrial Corp said Wednesday that its Electric Transit subsidiary and Czech manufacturer SKODA, a.s, will share a $170 million contract to build 250 electric trolly coaches for the City and County of San Francisco.
SKODA is a division of Germany's Volkswagon AG.
United Industrial says its share of the contract will total $50 million.

In a statement, Richard Erkeneff, president and chief executive officer of United Industrial said, "We see considerable potential in this area, and, as the only U.S. manufacturer of electric trolley vehicles, ETI is well positioned to take advantage of emerging opportunities."

ETI expects to begin production of the electric trolley coaches in late summer of this year, pending approval by the Federal Transportation Authority. Production will begin at SKODA's facility in the Czech Republic, where coach frames, with propulsion motors, will be manufactured and then shipped to AAI's operations in Hunt Valley, Maryland. Final assembly will take place at a new ETI facility in San Francisco.
